# Kasana

Kasana is an open-source, self-hosted personal finance application with an Indonesia-first experience. It is an independent adaptation of MoneyMatter v0.33.14 under AGPL-3.0.

- Source code: https://github.com/man612/Kasana
- Default local access after setup: http://localhost:8080
- Core areas: manual accounts, transactions, transfers, imports, budgets, reports, savings goals, assets, loans, and investments.
- Indonesian-language interface and IDR-oriented defaults; other supported currencies remain available.
- Automatic integration with Indonesian banks or e-wallets is not provided or claimed.
- A self-hosted instance does not require an account with the upstream hosted service.
- Local getting-started guide: /panduan.html
- Legal notice and corresponding source: /legal.html

Kasana is independent of the upstream MoneyMatter commercial service. See the repository README for development status, tested features, and deployment prerequisites.
